title: Slovakian Pasta Bolognese
description: A hearty pasta dish inspired by Slovakian cuisine, featuring a rich tomato-based sauce.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the Slovakian pasta according to package instructions until al dente.
In a large saucepan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for 3-4 minutes until they start to soften.
Add the tomato paste and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Stir in 1 cup of water to create a sauce. Bring the sauce to a simmer and let it cook for 10-15 minutes.
Add the cooked pasta to the saucepan and toss to coat with the tomato sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
